chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever seeks the pleasure of the people with what angers Allah, Mighty and Majestic, his praisers from the people will be condemners; and whoever prefers the obedience of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, even if it annoys the people, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will suffice him with the enmity of every enemy, the envy of every envious one, and the aggression of every aggressor, and Allah will be for him a Helper and a Supporter.'
ai.seo_question: What happens if I please people by disobeying God?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) elucidates the theological principle of *al-wala' wa al-bar'a* by contrasting the instability of human approval with the permanence of divine support. It serves as a practical guide for believers facing social pressure, assuring that prioritizing God's commandments, even at the cost of public opinion, guarantees Allah's protection from the enmity of all adversaries.
